summary: Round 2 test of STARPORT RUSH (offline Expo game) at 390x844 on the web preview, plus engine tests. Engine tests: 26 passed, 0 failed. All 10 requested flows work: L1 regression (win and deadlock with Undo/Restart), blocked-tap quip with moves staying 0, the COMBO x2 popup, fast-forward on tap, victory buttons (Next loads L2 in place with 3 bays; Share opens the card; Close and Replay work), the L2-L5 solutions each reaching victory, L5 'All Sectors Cleared' returning home with the notice and one home screen, progressive tile unlock and home-play-button, hint on L3-L5, and the L4/L5 layout with no element overflowing the viewport (4 compact bays show docked ships and seats). Only minor issues were found.

ui_bugs.issue: Headless Chromium has no navigator.share, so RN-web Share.share rejects twice and share-status says "Sharing isn't available here." Mobile browsers have navigator.share, so this case only affects desktop web. Suggestion: fall back to navigator.clipboard.writeText(shareText) and show 'Copied to clipboard'.

integration_issues.issue: The skipped timeline events never run their side effects. DEPART combo counting, cheer/party/grumpy moods, feedbackFor sounds/haptics and the wins/deadlocks diag bumps are all lost. Tapping fast through L1 (cyan, yellow, pink, 150ms apart) wins with no combo popup and bestCombo 0, so fast players get fewer combos. Suggestion: when fast-forwarding, loop over the remaining unplayed events and apply the combo, mood and diag logic without delays (and optionally skip audio).

issues: The victory overlay's 'Replay' button shows through the scrim in the gap between the share card and its Share/Close buttons. Use a more opaque backdrop for the share modal.
The 5-row alien queue at the start of L5 puts the top row's antennae right at the top edge of the terminal panel. It looks cramped, but nothing is clipped badly.

action_items: LOW: in useGameSession, apply the combo, mood and diag side effects of skipped events when fast-forwarding.
LOW: on web, add a clipboard fallback to ShareCard when navigator.share is unavailable.
LOW: make the share modal backdrop more opaque so the victory buttons don't show through.
critical_code_review_comments: useGameSession fast-forward is correct for state: core.current.state already holds the final state, so the display stays in sync. Only the side effects are dropped (see above).
game.tsx goNext uses router.setParams, and GameBody is keyed by levelId, so the session resets cleanly. The last level uses dismissTo('/'), leaving a single home in the stack (verified).
Level unlock logic in index.tsx is correct. Locked tiles are disabled (aria-disabled=true), and taps on them do nothing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (3 minor polish issues)

seed_data_creation: none (localStorage sr_stars_N set manually for unlock checks)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation call gets a fresh context. Set localStorage sr_stars_N to unlock tiles. /game?level=N opens a level directly. Waiting 3s between solution taps is reliable, and rapid 150ms taps also win thanks to fast-forward. Combo popup testID: combo-popup.
rca_of_issue: Missing combo on rapid taps: dispatch() calls clearTimers() while busy, which cancels the pending setTimeout callbacks. Those callbacks hold all the per-event logic (combo counting in DEPART, moods, feedback).
